title: Google Docs Adds Native Markdown File Editing, With Rendered .md Previews in Google Drive
key_facts: Google Drive and Docs add native support for markdown (.md) files
Real-time editing, comments and full rendering of formatting
Drive shows rendered markdown with clickable links and structured tables
Google says it helps AI agents collaborate on documents and sync with Gemini Notebook
Google's Chandu Thota calls markdown "the common language between humans and AI agents"
Rolling out from 5 Oct 2026; may take up to 15 days; on by default, even on admin-controlled accounts
quote_evidence: Spurred by the use of markdown files in the AI age, Google Drive and Google Docs are adding full, native support for markdown (.md) files.
Markdown support in Google Drive and Docs is rolling out starting today but may take up to 15 days to show up for everyone.
why_it_matters_hint: Markdown is the format AI agents and many people use for notes and instructions.
notes: gHacks original returned 403; read at 9to5Google (5 Oct 2026), which reports the same Google announcement. Rollout began before the window: score lowered by 1 (5 to 4).
